# NeuralNg Card Beta

Import Card only from `@neural-ng/core/card`. It is standalone; never create or
import an NgModule.

## Rules

- Use `neural-card` as the root.
- Import `NeuralCard` and compose `NeuralCardHeader`, `NeuralCardBody`, and
  `NeuralCardFooter` only when those sections are present.
- Never generate the deprecated `CardComponent`, `CardHeaderComponent`,
  `CardBodyComponent`, or `CardFooterComponent` aliases.
- Project native heading elements with stable IDs. Prefer `ariaLabelledby` on
  the card when it needs an accessible name.
- The root is a native article. Do not add `role="region"` to every card; use it
  only for an important named landmark.
- `cardClass` targets the native article.
- `classes` is typed with `root`, `header`, `body`, and `footer` slots.
- Section-level `headerClass`, `bodyClass`, and `footerClass` inputs are additive.
- `unstyled` removes visual `*-base` classes but retains structural classes,
  native semantics, ARIA, projection, and consumer classes.
- Global `provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true })` also affects Card.
- Do not assume Neural Icons, Tailwind, or another styling library is installed.
- Beta boundary: Card owns the semantic surface and section composition. It
  intentionally has no title, subtitle, media, action, click, or layout API;
  project real content and interactive components instead.

## Canonical example

```html
<neural-card ariaLabelledby="settings-title">
  <neural-card-header>
    <h2 id="settings-title">Settings</h2>
  </neural-card-header>
  <neural-card-body>
    <p>Update application preferences.</p>
  </neural-card-body>
  <neural-card-footer>
    <neural-button>Save</neural-button>
  </neural-card-footer>
</neural-card>
```
